opex.note: Engineers and researchers building the products and AI models.

follow100Note: A $2.2B paper gain on investments is inside the $3.53 of other income per $100. The rows may not add exactly due to rounding.
oneTimers: A $2,243M gain on equity securities — paper gains on stakes Alphabet holds — is inside the $2,843M of net other income; together with a $104M reversal of previously accrued performance fees, it added $1.9B to net income (about $0.15 a share), per the release's own footnote.
Employee severance and related charges of $716M were spread across cost of revenues and operating expenses, down from $1,994M a year ago.
otherDetail: A $2,243M gain on equity securities and $1,061M of interest income, partly offset by a $462M loss on debt securities, currency losses and interest expense, net.

segments.name: Google Services
segments.note: Search, YouTube, subscriptions and devices — Search & other revenue rose 14% to $46.2B and YouTube ads 21% to $8.1B.

segments.name: Google Cloud
segments.note: Cloud computing rented to companies — up 28%, and its operating profit rose to $900M from $191M a year ago.

segments.name: Other Bets
segments.note: Moonshot projects such as Waymo — small revenue and a $1.0B operating loss this quarter.

segments.name: Hedging gains
segments.note: Gains from currency hedging that sit outside the three businesses.

takeaways.text: Google Cloud revenue jumped 28% to $9.6B, and its operating profit rose to $900M from $191M a year ago — the cloud is becoming a real second engine.
takeaways.title: Cloud is compounding

takeaways.text: Operating margin expanded to 32% from 25% a year ago as revenue grew 15% and operating expenses actually fell 2% — severance charges dropped to $716M from $2.0B a year ago.
takeaways.title: Margins widened sharply

takeaways.text: The board declared Alphabet's first-ever cash dividend, $0.20 a share, and authorized up to $70B more in buybacks; net income rose 57% to $23.7B.
takeaways.title: Alphabet started paying a dividend

verdict: Alphabet grew revenue 15% to $80.5B as Search rose 14% and Google Cloud jumped 28% — and it kept $23.7B as profit, helped by a $2.2B paper gain on its investment stakes.
